profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Adobe/Frame.io
profile.summary: I'm a full-stack engineer specializing in distributed systems and functional languages/patterns with experience building green-field applications from the ground up, operating systems at massive scale, or maintaining large legacy codebases.  I'm the happiest when working on a small team of trusted developers solving problems with emerging technologies such as Elixir, Elm, Go, and Rust, and striving for quality, idiomatic, maintainable code. I'm a professional ballroom dancer, a juggler, unicyclist, and whitewater kayaker.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Scaled a Zanzibar-based authorization system from proof of concept to 4k req/s with p95 read latency under 1ms, which served as the authorization backend for all of Frame.io.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Consultant
positions.description:
Worked to develop teams from the inside out, improved communication, trust, and empathy, while applying language agnostic functional design patterns in production.

Recent engagements: 
  - Developed production Elixir for dynamic smart power grid software.
  - Removed bottlenecks and and improved performance on US Election volunteer and outreach software.
  - Developed and supported the GraphQL API for automotive sales platform; mentored teams in API security best practice and utilizing GraphQL as a flexible data access layer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Transformed product vision into an actionable/delivered technical solution while encouraging constant feedback through regular demoable prototypes; promoted an appreciation for functional programming style allowing for better productivity and code quality.  Heralded best-practice approach and use of emerging tech to offer concurrency advantages, cost savings, and performance gains for end users.
Developed a greenfield higher education  communications platform using React Native and Ionic backed by Elixir/Phoenix, Ruby on Rails and Golang as microservices within various Kubernetes environments. 
Self-taught ReactNative to demonstrate performance and UX advantages over webview based mobile platforms, and Ramda.js to streamline the redux functional approach.
Maintained, stabilized, and extended the legacy monolithic codebase.

positions.title: Founder & Developer
positions.description:
Developed a web application that integrates with university course enrollment and RateMyProfessors, providing students with tools to get into the classes of their choice with real-time enrollment monitoring, notifications, and analytics.
Transitioned from 100% back-end development to full-stack development by self-teaching  technologies such as React/Redux

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a backend team in the advertising department, integrating our business entities with provider APIs such as google and msn, and generated and transmitted reporting data for analytics.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Learned the tools of the trade for distributed systems on a java based stack including RabbitMQ, Java Spring Framework, and MySql.  As part of an AGILE team, I participated in development of new products and maintained current apps.

positions.title: Designer & Developer Associate
positions.description: Developed Javascript for interactivity features, graphic design of websites in Photoshop, Website Layout and Styling in CSS

honors.title: Computer Science Fair 2nd Place
honors.description: Placed 2nd at UVM computer science competition with project "Classify," to streamline the course registration and planning process.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteer helping with registration and organizing competitors for their upcoming heats at USA Dance ballroom competitions around the east coast.
Developed an integrated platform for dance teachers and organizations around vermont to host a profile and post events.

projects.title: Classify
projects.description: Developed a web application that provides users with automatic notifications of course openings so that students do not need to periodically check back for updates.  Classify provides a holistic view of course registration, pulling together the latest data about courses from various sources provided by UVM and dynamically pulling professor ratings from popular websites.  The app makes course selection easy as it automatically maps classes you are interested in into a clean weekly schedule allow the user to compare classes side by side.

projects.title: USA Dance VT - CMS and role based event management app
projects.description: Developed an application from the ground up using Slim PHP, Doctrine, and Twig to manage dance events, instructors and organizations from around Vermont. Users can request access to certain entities, post events, send newsletters, and manage their profiles.
